I'll start by finding the web-landing repo and its signup form. I won't edit anything yet, because the consent wording and default state are decisions for you.

TOOL: ls ..
TOOL: find ../web-landing -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/node_modules*' -not -path '*/.git/*' \( -iname '*signup*' -o -iname '*subscribe*' -o -iname '*register*' -o -iname '*newsletter*' \)
TOOL: grep -ril --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git -E 'signup|sign-up|newsletter|subscribe' ../web-landing
